summary.text: Brian Lambert is the Libertarian Party nominee for Florida's 14th Congressional District; the Libertarian primary was canceled. He is a retired U.S. Navy veteran who served 20 years and completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Lambert graduated from Cairo High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Ashford University in 2018.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1998 to 2018. In his Ballotpedia survey he says his roles included Aircraft Mechanic, Flight Engineer, and Intelligence Specialist.
